title: Choose matching results
summary: REST API Development: Choose matching results. Design a filter for books with at least 20 pages.
introduction: A query string can describe a filter. The exact parameter names belong to the API design.
learningObjectives: Choose matching results with REST API Development
Design a filter for books with at least 20 pages

blocks.text: Read the request and response pairs in a text editor. They show only headers useful to each idea. No server, account or installation is needed for these exercises; /books is an imaginary practice API.

blocks.title: Choose matching results
blocks.code:
GET /books?colour=blue HTTP/1.1
Host: example.test

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

[{"id":1,"colour":"blue"}]

blocks.text: The query parameter says colour=blue. The worked result includes a book satisfying that filter.

blocks.title: Expected result
blocks.content: Only matching blue books are returned.

blocks.text: Design a filter for books with at least 20 pages.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Document filter rules rather than making clients guess them.
